source: Azure content safety Annotate contract, contracts/rai.proto in the Service-ContentModerator-vnext repository.
why: AgentControlSpecification.ContentSafety declares neutral copies of these enumerations so the package builds without a dependency on a non public service. The numeric values are part of the contract, because a caller may translate by value rather than by name. This fixture pins them so a reordering is caught by a test rather than by a mis-routed payload.
